items.title: Epochal launches with $100M to help developers train predictive AI models
items.summary:
Artificial intelligence tooling startup Epochal AI Inc. launched today with $100 million in funding. The capital was provided by Chief Executive Officer Guodong Zhang, a machine learning researcher who earlier co-founded xAI Corp.
